text: Group multiple data sources into a collection searchable via one endpoint
quote: A collection is a group of different data sources that you can search using a single endpoint.

text: Source connections handle authentication and automatically sync data from an app or database
quote: A source connection links a specific app or database to your collection. It handles authentication and automatically syncs data.

text: Direct vector search mode optimized for speed, ~0.5 second latency
quote: Direct vector search. Use when speed is critical (~0.5sec).

text: An AI agent iteratively searches data with multiple strategies and navigates entity parent/child/sibling hierarchies to build results
quote: An AI agent iteratively searches your data using tool calling. It searches with multiple strategies, reads full documents, navigates entity hierarchies (parent/child/sibling), and builds a comprehensive result set.

text: Official MCP server implementing Model Context Protocol so AI assistants can search synced data
quote: The Airweave MCP server implements the Model Context Protocol to let AI assistants search your synced data.

text: Search any collection directly from a terminal CLI
quote: The primary use case — search any collection from your terminal

text: Publishes official skills so agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and similar tools can set up integrations and search data
quote: Airweave publishes official skills so that agents in Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other environments can set up integrations and search your data without you having to explain how every time.

text: Airweave Connect: hosted embeddable UI widget letting end users connect apps like Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion inside your product
quote: Airweave Connect is a hosted, embeddable UI widget that lets end users connect their apps (Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion, and more) directly inside your product.

text: Sends real-time webhook notifications for events like sync completion, connection creation, and collection updates
quote: Webhooks are real-time notifications that Airweave sends when things happen in your organization: syncs completing, source connections being created, collections being updated.

text: Authentication providers let you reuse existing authenticated connections from platforms like Composio or Pipedream
quote: Authentication providers let you reuse existing authenticated connections from third-party platforms such as Composio or Pipedream.

text: Can be self-hosted from open-source code via git clone and a start script
AI agents can search across company knowledge bases, cloud drives, databases, and SaaS tools in a single query
quote: Airweave lets AI agents search across company knowledge bases, cloud drives, databases, and SaaS tools in a single query.
